newsitem.title: POLAND: KPBP sees 1996 net profit at PLN 2.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: KPBP sees 1996 net profit at PLN 2.1 mln.

text.p: Polish construction company KPBP Bick SA, listed on the bourse's main market, said on Tuesday that its net profit forecast for this year was 2.1 million zlotys.
KPBP's net profit forecast for 1997 and 1998 is 2.5 million zlotys and 3.2 million zlotys, respectively, the company said in a statement. The firm netted 1.6 million zlotys last year.
The sales forecast for this year, 1997 and 1998 is 68.2, 80.5 and 95 million zlotys, respectively, it said. KPBP's sales were 58.3 million zlotys last year.
